players.product: Vera Rubin platform (Rubin GPU, Vera CPU, NVLink switch, Spectrum-X / Quantum-X networking)

quarterly_data.signal: CEO Jensen Huang on open versus closed models: 'I would say nearly all open models run on NVIDIA', because NVIDIA's footprint around the world is the highest and its architecture the most fungible; 'I'm fairly certain we're the only platform that runs every frontier model, whether it's closed or open'; closed and open models are 'both simultaneously driving our sales.'

CFO Colette Kress on why NVIDIA backs the frontier AI labs: they 'are growing faster than what their balance sheets and credit profiles can support' and 'still lack the decades-long infrastructure contracts and investment-grade financing capacity needed to secure the AI factory infrastructure independently' — 'their growth is not limited by their technology or customer demand. It is limited by compute.' The nearly $50 billion invested in the labs 'represented a small fraction of our expected free cash flow over the same period.' CEO Jensen Huang: 'I think the only regret that I have is that I didn't invest more and sooner.'
quarterly_data.figure: nearly $50 billion invested in frontier AI labs

connects_to.relationship: Vera Rubin systems for OCI AI cloud capacity

contracts.signal: CFO Colette Kress: 'We expect Vera to be deployed by every major hyperscaler, neocloud, AI lab, and system OEM, with shipments already underway to our lead partners, including OCI, SpaceXAI, and starting this quarter, AWS.'
